verdict.rationale: The docs give one-command, in-agent installs: `devin plugins install obra/superpowers` with skills auto-triggering at session start, and the Claude Code marketplace `/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace`. Antigravity runs the session-start hook so Superpowers is active from the first message. A real hands-on probe confirmed `npx skills add obra/superpowers` fetches and installs skills cleanly. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that skills activate in the next session (the probe only verified the files were installed), a true one-liner on every harness (Claude Code needs a marketplace-add step first, and Codex/OpenCode installs go through the agent fetching an INSTALL.md).
